critical_code_review_comments: Minor defensive coding gap: In SubRecipeStockPanel handleSaveAll validation loop (lines 71-78), getDrift(sub) is called without null-checking `sub` first. If an entry ID doesn't match any subRecipe, `sub.id` would throw. In the actual save loop (line 84), there's a `if (!sub) continue` guard — same guard should be added to the validation loop. Low risk in practice since entries can only be created from rendered rows.

SubRecipeStockPanel line 261: Hardcoded <option value='physical_count'>Physical stock count</option> appended after wastageReasons from API. This creates an option with a string value 'physical_count' while all API reasons use numeric IDs. The reasonLabel lookup (line 88) will return '' for this value since wastageReasons.find won't match. Consider using a numeric sentinel or handling this string value explicitly in the API payload.
